name: Ethiopian Misir Wot
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) red lentils, rinsed
3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger, minced
steps: Dry-cook the onion in a heavy pot for 6 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden; add the oil.
Add the garlic, ginger and berbere and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, lentils and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick and stew-like.
Season with salt and lemon juice.
note: Traditionally made with spiced clarified butter (niter kibbeh); here a little oil is used instead, so it is vegan.
